parsed.reply: In Spanish, verbs like «picar» in this sense are used with an indirect object pronoun («me», «te», «le») rather than a subject pronoun because the itch is the subject doing the action to you — literally, «The nose itches me» («Me pica la nariz»). Saying «yo pico» would mean «I sting» or «I chop», changing the meaning entirely.
